  "decisions": [
    {
      "id": "dec-001",
      "date": "2026-09-21",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "Package manager and module standards",
      "decision": "Use pnpm as package manager; TypeScript ESM only ('type': 'module') across Node runtime and scripts.",
      "rationale": "Project-level requirements and user rules."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-002",
      "date": "2026-09-21",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "Repo and domain target",
      "decision": "Remote repo set to https://github.com/Catalyst-Forge-LLC/efficacy.git with efficacy.dev as public domain target.",
      "rationale": "Defined in project kickoff."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-003",
      "date": "2026-09-21",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "Spec authority",
      "decision": "docs/efficacy-spec-v0.3.md is the active specification for the project. Haulout doc ignored for initial kickoff.",
      "rationale": "User prompt directive."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-004",
      "date": "2026-09-22",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "Monorepo layout",
      "decision": "pnpm workspace with packages/core, packages/cli, and site/.",
      "rationale": "User confirmed monorepo. Core stays usable without the CLI; the spec site stays separate from the crypto package."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-005",
      "date": "2026-09-22",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "v1 hero flow",
      "decision": "efficacy init writes a genesis JSONL line, efficacy record appends a use line, efficacy verify walks the chain and reports the first failed check or a trust tier.",
      "rationale": "User confirmed this as the v1 hero flow."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-006",
      "date": "2026-09-22",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "Do not invent spec-open answers",
      "decision": "v1 will not define a key registry, a shared public-key directory, cross-repo bridging, or per-kind evidence schemas.",
      "rationale": "efficacy-spec-v0.3 leaves those unresolved and says implementations must not invent them."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-007",
      "date": "2026-09-22",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "Spec site and hosting",
      "decision": "site/ is a FilePress static site. efficacy.dev is registered at Cloudflare. DNS and production hosting are Cloudflare, with Pages for the site. No application database. No desktop GUI.",
      "rationale": "User confirmed the stack and that the domain is already on Cloudflare."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-008",
      "date": "2026-09-22",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "Local port for the spec site",
      "decision": "LocalSlip claims the FilePress dev port. Do not pass a hardcoded port and do not add a package only to read the lease.",
      "rationale": "User accepted LocalSlip for the site. ColdEye and xFacts stay deferred."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-009",
      "date": "2026-09-22",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "Published npm package name",
      "decision": "The public package name is efficacy. packages/core stays private to the workspace.",
      "rationale": "The user staked the npm name efficacy. One public package is enough for v1."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-010",
      "date": "2026-09-22",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "title": "Implementation license",
      "decision": "The code is Apache-2.0. The spec stays CC0.",
      "rationale": "User accepted Apache-2.0 so adopters receive a contributor patent grant."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-011",
      "date": "2026-09-22",
      "phase": "2-scaffolding",
      "title": "Release path",
      "decision": "pnpm ship deploys the site with wrangler pages deploy. The CLI ships as one bundled dist/main.js, published with npm publish from packages/cli.",
      "rationale": "Matches the sibling FilePress repos. Node does not strip types under node_modules, so the published bin must be JavaScript."
    },
    {
      "id": "dec-012",
      "date": "2026-09-22",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "title": "Verification boundary and tier 4",
      "decision": "Verify reports record integrity, not claim truth. Retracted records lose their tier and cannot confirm. Tier 4 needs a later passing tier-3 use of the same tool name, version, and hash with different evidence; same-key confirmations are labelled not independent. Signature notes say key_id was not resolved. Proposed spec changes (measurement basis, observer, chain_url, private evidence, independent signer) live in docs/efficacy-spec-v0.4-draft.md and are not implemented until accepted.",
      "rationale": "External README review: proof wording overclaimed, savings-only measurement invites invented counterfactuals, and retracted records still showed a tier."
    }
